name: Feature Request

---

### Feature Summary
A clear and concise description of the feature or capability you would like added.

### Proposed Command or Interface
How should users or administrators interact with this feature? (e.g. `/ic exam reminder` or `/ic admin alert_format`)

```
/ic ...
```

### Problem or Use Case
What problem does this feature solve for your campus community or student server?

### External APIs & Data Dependencies
- Does this feature require an external API? (e.g. university open data, transit feed, career board)
- Does the external API require authentication or have rate limits?
- How should the bot behave offline or if the API is down?

### Privacy & Data Safety
- What data (if any) will be stored in SQLite?
- Does this feature involve any user-submitted files or chat message parsing?
- Confirm: This feature does not require collecting student PII (real names, student IDs, emails).

### Security Check
- [ ] I confirm that this proposal does not contain private server lore, real credentials, or production tokens.
